entries.deep_essence: Ge Hong’s Outer Chapters form a Confucian-leaning political-ethical counterpart to the Inner Chapters’ alchemy: 用世 (engagement), 嘉遁 (worthy withdrawal), 臣道, and critique of empty talk vs. practical talent (才). Doctrines stress 仁义 as social order, 博学而约取, and that true 隐 is not escape but measured service—mirroring BaZi’s tension between 身强/用神 as public agency vs. 印比 as retreat when the chart cannot bear office.
entries.key_passages: 「抱朴子曰：道者，儒之本也；儒者，道之末也。」「嘉遁以全志，仕以行道。」「知足不辱，知止不殆。」
